name: Virtual TV
description: Virtual linear TV channels generated from media already available in Jellyfin.
overview: Virtual linear TV channels inside Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Virtual TV 2.0.1.1 improves channel-management UI and Save feedback, stabilizes Personalized TV handoff on Jellyfin for Android, prevents failed handoffs from leaving an infinite Loading screen, and makes Hide from Android TV compatible with legacy/current Android TV client names including Google TV and Fire TV deployments.

Virtual TV 2.0.1.0 adds per-channel Standard TV quality (480p, 720p or 1080p), Clone Channel, Android TV Record-to-Play-from-Beginning compatibility, optional Hide from Android TV for Personalized channels, and an Android phone/tablet-specific Personalized TV handoff. Web and webOS behavior remains unchanged.

Virtual TV 2.0 full release. This release promotes the validated 1.10.19 runtime behavior without changing scheduling or playback logic. It retains Standard TV, Personalized TV, weighted True Random, Guide text polish, Content Coverage and the Standard TV Record-to-Play-from-Beginning shortcut. Release packaging now includes a Jellyfin repository manifest with the canonical Virtual TV GUID and developer R-BCK-gitgub so Jellyfin can display repository metadata when the manifest is configured as an accessible plugin repository.
